attributes.name: Tomato Leaf Disease Detection and Classification Using Custom Modified AlexNet

attributes.summary:
● Developed a ML model to identify and classify resumes, improving resume processing accuracy.
● Built a resume ranking system, enhancing candidate evaluation speed and efficiency.

● I developed a customized machine learning model based on clients specific needs, and regularly refining the model based on their feedback, resulting in increase in model prediction accuracy.
● I provided precise manual data annotation services by employing thorough and accurate labeling techniques, which improved model training effectiveness and resulted in increase in overall model accuracy.

● I developed and optimized a high-precision Contract Advisor RAG system for detailed legal contract Q&A, enhancing accuracy and efficiency in contract analysis through advanced techniques like Query Expansion.

● I improved a text-to-image system by utilizing stable diffusion and advanced prompt engineering techniques, including iterative testing and refinement, resulting in increase in image quality and relevance.
● I fine-tuned the LLama 2-7b model using Ethereum data, optimizing it through targeted parameter adjustments and extensive validation, which resulted in improvement in query accuracy.
● I led the AI division by directing cross-functional teams,and fostering a collaborative environment to develop and implement AI technologies, enhancing product efficiency and driving technological advancements.

attributes.role: Researcher, Machine Learning and Robotics Engineer
attributes.summary:
● I conducted cutting-edge AI research and published two papers in reputable journals by performing rigorous experimentation and analysis, which provided valuable insights to the field and advanced the state of AI research, contributing to the development of new methodologies and applications.
● I developed a tomato leaf disease detection and classification system using a custom modified AlexNet by carefully designing and training the model to identify and classify various diseases, which helped farmers manage crop health more effectively, reducing crop losses and improving its productivity.
● I designed and assembled robotic systems by handling both the technical design and construction as well as programming the robots to perform specific tasks, resulting in more efficient and reliable robotic solutions for various applications.

● I provided comprehensive IT support, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and ensuring the smooth operation of computer systems. This included setting up and maintaining network infrastructure, assisting users with technical problems, and implementing security measures to protect data integrity.

● I successfully developed a sophisticated text-to-speech (TTS) system tailored for a local language, enhancing accessibility and communication for native speakers. This involved designing and implementing advanced speech synthesis algorithms to ensure natural and accurate pronunciation.
● I curated and annotated an extensive dataset specifically for text-to-speech applications. This dataset included diverse linguistic elements, phonetic variations, and contextual nuances to train and fine-tune the TTS model, ensuring high-quality and reliable speech output.
